disable_torch_dynamo: disable TorchDynamo on a function or context manager to skip dynamic compilation
run_optimize_function: run a function using TorchDynamo's RunOnlyContext to use prior optimizations without recompiling
allow_function_in_graph: allow a custom function to be included inline in a TorchDynamo generated graph
mark_tensor_dynamic_dim: mark a tensor dimension as dynamic so TorchDynamo handles it with dynamic shapes
disallow_function_in_graph: disallow a function from being in a TorchDynamo graph and force a graph break
